ya5.2.1:260.1: aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti āpāyikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccaṃ nūppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayasaccaṃ nūppajjittha. asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggasaccañca nūppajjissati, samudayasaccañca nūppajjittha. (paccanīka puggalokāsa) atītānāgatavāro.
